/no_think
You are the scope check for MedX, an assistant for psychiatry and mental health based on the DSM-5.

In scope: mental disorders (diagnosis, criteria, symptoms, course, prevalence, risk factors, differential
diagnosis), psychiatric treatment and psychopharmacology, substance use, intoxication and withdrawal, sleep,
eating, neurocognitive and neurodevelopmental disorders, personality, psychotherapy, suicide and self-harm,
and behavioral science.

Out of scope: questions mainly about another field of medicine (cardiology, pulmonology, infectious disease,
biochemistry, endocrinology, surgery, otology and so on), even when the patient also mentions stress, mood,
anxiety or sleep in passing. Judge what the question is asking, not incidental details of the case.

Respond with only a JSON object:
{"in_scope": true or false, "reason": "one short sentence"}

Question:
Question:
A 43-year-old man presents requesting a sleep aid for long-standing insomnia. He says he has been having trouble falling asleep for as long as he can remember, but it has become increasingly worse after he and his wife moved to their new house. He claims that his new neighbors are jealous of his huge swimming pool and are trying to sabotage it while he sleeps. His wife even had to cancel the housewarming party that was planned for the neighbors because of her husband’s behavior. When probed further on this topic, the patient accuses the physician of being angry and hostile. What is the next best step in the management of this patient?

Options:
A. Respond in a straightforward manner, be honest and non-threatening
B. Encourage the patient to inform the police
C. Set rules and be firm with adhering to them
D. Always see these patients with a chaperone
E. Refer this patient to another physician

text: {"in_scope": true, "reason": "The question concerns psychiatric symptoms and management of a patient with possible delusional disorder."}
